records.source: エスピナス希少種の特徴を参{j}考にして作成された、聴覚保護{j}特化ガンナー用脚防具。
records.previous: Created with reference{j}to the traits of the Espinas Rare Species, this leg armor is for Gunners specialized in Hearing Protection{j}.
records.target: Leg armor for Hearing Protection Gunners{j}based on Espinas Rare Species traits.{j}Built for specialized hearing protection.

records.source: 赤闘獣の紅毛や極鉄など素材{j}で生産した重厚な脚防具。{j}精巧な金属細工が美しい。
records.previous: Heavy Legs armor crafted from{j}materials such as the Red Violent Beast's crimson fur and extreme iron.{j}Its intricate metalwork is beautiful.
records.target: Heavy leg armor of crimson fur and iron.{j}Crafted from Red Violent Beast materials.{j}Beautiful intricate metalwork.

records.source: 大型の骨から強化される大剣。{j}重量で破壊力を得る骨大剣で、{j}これを扱えるなら一人前。
records.previous: A Great Sword upgraded from a large bone.{j}A bone Great Sword whose weight gives it destructive power;{j}if you can wield it, you are a full-fledged Hunter.
records.target: Great Sword upgraded from large bone.{j}Its weight grants destructive power.{j}Wield it to become a full-fledged Hunter.

records.source: 訓練所で流した血と汗の結晶。{j}あの熱き日々が胸に去来する。{j}教官は元気にしてるだろうか。
records.previous: The crystallized blood and sweat shed at the Training School.{j}Those passionate days come flooding back.{j}I wonder if the Instructor is doing well.
records.target: Training School sweat and blood.{j}Those passionate days come flooding back.{j}I wonder if the Instructor is well.

records.source: 訓練所で流した血と汗の結晶。{j}あの熱き日々が胸に去来する。{j}たまには顔を出してあげよう。
records.previous: The crystallized blood and sweat shed at the Training School.{j}Those passionate days come flooding back.{j}I should drop by and show my face sometime.
records.target: Training School sweat and blood.{j}Those passionate days come flooding back.{j}I should visit and show my face sometime.

records.source: 訓練所で流した血と汗の結晶。{j}あの熱き日々が胸に去来する。{j}流した涙も無駄にはならない。
records.previous: The crystallized blood and sweat shed at the Training School.{j}Those passionate days come flooding back.{j}Even the tears shed were not in vain.
records.target: Training School sweat and blood.{j}Those passionate days come flooding back.{j}Even the tears shed were not in vain.

records.source: 姿を見ることさえかなわない、{j}伝説の金竜銀竜の素材を用い{j}た双剣。火属性が非常に強力。
records.previous: Dual Blades whose form can never even be glimpsed,{j}forged from the materials of the legendary gold and silver dragons{j}. The Fire element is extremely powerful.
records.target: Dual Blades forged from legendary gold and{j}silver dragons. Their Fire element is{j}extremely powerful.

records.source: 最強の封龍剣をさらに超える{j}絶一門の最終兵器。全てが謎{j}の素材は太古の文明の名残か。
records.previous: Surpassing even the strongest Dragon Seal Sword{j}The ultimate weapon of the Absolute. Everything is a mystery.{j}Are these materials vestiges of an ancient civilization?
records.target: Ultimate weapon surpassing the strongest{j}Dragon Seal Sword. Its materials remain a{j}mystery, perhaps ancient remnants.

records.source: 名工がこしらえた宝石細工の{j}槍の強化版。美しい装飾のみ{j}ならず、実用性の高さも好評。
records.previous: An upgraded version of the jewel-worked{j}Lance fashioned by a master artisan. It is well regarded not{j}only for its beautiful ornamentation, but for its high practicality as well.
records.target: Upgraded jewel-worked Lance by a master.{j}Beautiful ornamentation and practical{j}performance earn equal praise.

records.source: ギルドの研究と工房の技術向上{j}で、古の封龍剣が完全復活。{j}太古の叡智が手の中に。
records.previous: Through the Guild's research and the workshop's advances{j}, the ancient Sealed Dragon Sword is fully revived.{j}The wisdom of the ancients is now in your hands.
records.target: Guild research and Workshop advances{j}revive the ancient Sealed Dragon Sword.{j}Ancient wisdom is now in your hands.

scope: Two exact-source leg-armor and eight melee-description patterns.
